:::{#thm-vcov-vec}

#### The variance matrix of a random vector is its expected self outer product minus the self outer product of its mean

For a $p \times 1$ [random vector](random-variables.qmd#def-random-variable) $\vX$
with $\E{X_i^2} < \infty$ for every $i$,
the [variance matrix](#def-cov-vec-x) of $\vX$ is the [expectation of](expectation.qmd#def-expectation-matrix) the [outer product](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/linear-algebra-inner-products.html#def-outer-product) of $\vX$ with itself,
minus the outer product of its [mean](expectation.qmd#def-expectation-matrix) $\Expp\vX$ with itself:

$$
\Varf{\vX} = \Expf{\soprod{\vX}} - \soprod{\paren{\Expp\vX}}
$$

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

::: proof

Start from @thm-vcov-outer-product:

$$
\ba
\Varf{\vX}
&= \Expf{
    \soprod{\devn(\vX)}
  }
&& \text{(outer-product form of the variance matrix)}
\\
&= \Expf{
    \soprod{\vX}
    - \oprod{\vX}{\paren{\Expp\vX}}
    - \oprod{\paren{\Expp\vX}}{\vX}
    + \soprod{\paren{\Expp\vX}}
  }
&& \text{(expand the product)}
\\
&= \Expf{\soprod{\vX}}
  - \soprod{\paren{\Expp\vX}}
  - \soprod{\paren{\Expp\vX}}
  + \soprod{\paren{\Expp\vX}}
&& \text{(linearity, element-wise; } \Expp\vX \text{ is constant)}
\\
&= \Expf{\soprod{\vX}}
  - \soprod{\paren{\Expp\vX}}
&& \text{(combine like terms)}
\ea
$$

:::
